copy.tagline: 按计划分步执行代码任务并设置审查节点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有详细的实现计划需要分步执行并接受审查
copy.tagline_en: Execute implementation plans step by step with review checkpoints
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a detailed implementation plan to execute in stages with review

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先宣布使用本技能，再读你的书面计划并批判性审查，有疑虑先问你；然后按计划逐项执行并验证，完成时调用专门的收尾技能；途中受阻会停下求助，不擅自猜测。
howto.when: 当你有书面实施计划、要在独立会话中按审查检查点执行时触发。比如给出计划并要求 Claude 分步实施。

say.text: 请审查这份实施计划，有问题先问我，再开始执行。
say.note: Claude 会先批判性审查，有疑虑会提出。

say.text: 按照计划逐项执行，每个任务验证通过后继续。
say.note: 它会标记进度并运行验证。

say.text: 执行到一半遇到阻碍就停下，告诉我原因。
say.note: 受阻时它会停止并询问你，而非猜测。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will announce the skill, then read and critically review your written plan, raising concerns before starting; it executes tasks step by step with verifications, finishes with a dedicated closing skill, and stops to ask you when blocked rather than guessing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a written implementation plan to execute in a separate session with review checkpoints, such as when you provide a plan and ask Claude to implement it step by step.

say_en.text: Please review this implementation plan, ask me if you have concerns, then start.
say_en.note: Claude reviews critically and raises concerns first.

say_en.text: Execute the plan task by task, verifying each step before continuing.
say_en.note: It tracks progress and runs verifications.

say_en.text: If you hit a blocker midway, stop and tell me why.
say_en.note: It stops and asks you instead of guessing.
